fewShots.question: How many tonnes of ore were mined per year?
fewShots.query:
select FactMaterialStream.ReportingYear,
    sum(FactMaterialStream.ValueTonnes) as OreMinedTonnes
from [production].[FactMaterialStream] as FactMaterialStream
where FactMaterialStream.StreamTypeCode = 'ORE MINED'
group by FactMaterialStream.ReportingYear

fewShots.question: Which countries have the most facilities?
fewShots.query:
select top 10 DimFacility.Country,
    count(DimFacility.Facility_BK) as FacilityCount
from [facilities].[DimFacility] as DimFacility
where DimFacility.DimFacility_SK <> -1
group by DimFacility.Country
order by count(DimFacility.Facility_BK) desc

fewShots.question: What was the total waste per mining method in the latest year?
fewShots.query:
select FactWaste.MiningMethodCode,
    FactWaste.ReportingYear,
    sum(FactWaste.ValueTonnes) as WasteTonnes
from [production].[FactWaste] as FactWaste
where FactWaste.ReportingYear = (
    select max(LatestWaste.ReportingYear)
    from [production].[FactWaste] as LatestWaste
)
group by FactWaste.MiningMethodCode, FactWaste.ReportingYear

fewShots.question: How many tonnes were transported by each mode of transport?
fewShots.query:
select FactTransport.TransportBy,
    sum(FactTransport.ValueTonnes) as TransportTonnes
from [production].[FactTransport] as FactTransport
group by FactTransport.TransportBy

fewShots.question: Which materials have the largest reserves?
fewShots.query:
select top 10 DimMaterial.MaterialName,
    sum(FactReserve.MineralValueTonnes) as ReserveTonnes
from [production].[FactReserve] as FactReserve
inner join [production].[DimMaterial] as DimMaterial
    on DimMaterial.DimMaterial_SK = FactReserve.DimMaterial_SK
group by DimMaterial.MaterialName
order by sum(FactReserve.MineralValueTonnes) desc

fewShots.question: Who owns and operates each facility?
fewShots.query:
select top 20 DimFacility.FacilityName,
    FactFacilityOwnership.OwnershipYear,
    FactFacilityOwnership.Owners,
    FactFacilityOwnership.Operators
from [facilities].[FactFacilityOwnership] as FactFacilityOwnership
inner join [facilities].[DimFacility] as DimFacility
    on DimFacility.DimFacility_SK = FactFacilityOwnership.DimFacility_SK
